items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1960-09-16
items.q: Yeah, I've heard of that band. John Robichaud. He used to play at the Lyric Theater. He's a good trombone player.

ctx.x: I wonder if you could tell us a little bit more. I'm interested in Vic Gaspar especially since I never got to talk to him or even meet him. Did you hear him with any dance bands much in those days? Oh yeah, there was lots of dance bands. Was he still playing then when you came to town? Oh sure. He's playing. He played at the Lyric Theater. I was in town since 1910. Oh I didn't know. I thought maybe you didn't get here until 1925 or something. No, no, no. Oh you came down early then. Oh I didn't know. Vic Gaspar…
Yeah, I've heard of that band. John Robichaud. He used to play at the Lyric Theater. He's a good trombone player.

What style did he have? Did he have a big tone? Did he do much sliding? Or was it a rough style or smooth or how? Smooth. He's smooth. Smooth. He used to tell me all the time one good note is better than a thousand bad notes.
